Represents how many stat points (SP) each cost value will give. For example, Bones have a 1:1 ratio for cost to stats, eg, 4 Bones will give 4 stat points.

DOES NOT ACTUALLY AFFECT ANYTHING ON ITS OWN. You must provide the logic that reads and uses this value.
